pilot_disclosure: A 5-case seed-24021 pilot was examined before freezing the method. Pilot is not independent evidence.
stream_spec: Length 240; uniform noise ±0.26; baseline0; isolated ±7 shocks at 42,87,173,211; gradual drift +0.005*t; abrupt +3 at 120; five kinds steady/spike/drift/step/step_spike.

detection.step_classification: Within trailing 20 adjacent samples, any same-sign jump >1.5 classifies persistent displacement as step; otherwise drift.
detection.no_cross_epoch_retraining: New promoted reference stored as an immutable event, earlier references preserved.

holdout: Fresh 30 deterministic seeds per category (150 traces), no threshold changes after freeze.

expected.drift: at least one drift alert, no step alarms
expected.step: at least one step alarm within [120,145]
expected.step_spike: at least one step alarm within [120,145]

limitations: Classification heuristic rather than formal guarantee; pilot-informed thresholds
